answer: PoA deters Sybil control by binding each identity to bonded collateral: when k coordinated identities equivocate on the same conflicting state, correlated penalties grow as O(k²), rather than as k independent fines. Detection slashes escrowed stake and applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, so adding identities increases shared downside; mirror votes, mesa-like clusters, and ridge-separated operators can still be linked by coordination evidence.
